# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]

### From Pump to Pup: Finding Comfort in 'Baxter'

Izzy, a young cancer fighter and survivor, loves her dog, Baxter, named after the brand she saw on
the infusion pumps that delivered her chemotherapy.

[Read More][54]
[nurse smiling and standing next to a window ]
[Healthcare Insights][55]

Conditions such as hypertension, respiratory illnesses and cardiac issues can be monitored
effectively with innovative tools and connected devices.

# Compassionate care wherever you call home

As the nation’s leading hospice, palliative, and home health provider, our mission is to provide
exceptional care to patients and their families. It is our privilege to offer the support you need
and the dignity and kindness you deserve.

[Find Care Near You][47]

## Our services

We’re committed to working with you and your family members to provide the best care possible.

[Hospice care]

### Hospice Care

When a loved one is facing a life-limiting illness, they need care that goes beyond pain and symptom
management. Our teams of nurses, social workers, volunteers, aides, and chaplains attend to people’s
emotional, spiritual, and physical needs during this challenging time, so patients and families can
make the most of every moment.

[Learn more][48]
[Palliative care]

### Palliative Care

If you or a loved one is living with a serious, complex illness, our team of caregivers and
clinicians can offer you expert relief and help you manage your symptoms and improve your overall
quality of life.

[Learn more][49]
[Home Health care]

### Home Health Care

Whether recovering from surgery or managing a chronic medical condition, our clinicians can help you
get back to doing the things you love with personalized skilled nursing care and therapy—all in the
comfort of the place you call home.

[Learn more][50]
[Advanced illness management]

### Advanced Illness Management

For people navigating complex illnesses, our team is there to light the way. We offer advanced
illness management—specialized care designed to provide relief from the symptoms and stress of
illness while improving quality of life wherever our patients call home.

[Learn more][51]

## Find care near you

All services Hospice care Palliative care Home Health care Search

## People are at the heart of everything we do

For those nearing the end of life, few things mean as much as the kindness and respect they receive

# AccuMed Behavioral Health EHR

AccuMed Behavioral Health EHR / EMR (Electronic Medical Records) solution addresses the complexities
you encounter in your financial and clinical program management.

# INTELLIGENT SOFTWARE THAT THINKS ABOUT YOUR BUSINESS

As a healthcare professional or medical institution, you want the assurance of secure, reliable,
value-driven solutions to help manage ever expanding data and daily office procedures. You want
HIPAA compliant protection and rapidly accessible information. You want the assurance of
unparalleled customer service every step of the way and the knowledge that your systems will be as
easy to use as they are efficient. You want the assurance of Accumedic’s 40 years of visionary
innovation; delivering the ultimate in powerful, easy to use, reliable software solutions for
Practice Management Software, Behavioral Healthcare EHR and Electronic Medical Records (EMR/EHR).

## Products and Effective Solutions

### Answers To Your Challenges

[1]

### Cloud EHR For Behavioral Health

Agencies today are continually faced with government mandated system requirements, rising IT
maintenance costs, and the need to increase
efficiency and improve quality of care.

adaptable clinical record and industry-leading
billing system for comprehensive clinic
management.

Eliminate day-to-day tasks and accelerate reimbursements with a professionally managed billing
process. Enjoy instant access to accurate,
real-time financial data and monitor the entire revenue cycle with customized analytics. 

[4]

### Telehealth

 

Simple, secure and fully integrated
telehealth solution for your behavioral healthcare agency.

[5]

### Behavioral Health EHR

When facing increased regulations and
growing case loads, you need solutions that make it easier for you to manage day-to-day operations.
AccuMed Behavioral Health EHR is created for
mental health professionals. 

[6]

### Practice Management

 

At a time when physicians, medical
practitioners, health care providers and
administrators are concerned with reducing costs and maximizing efficiency while still delivering
quality service

business, that’s why AccuMed’s Electronic  Medical Records Software features the broadest range of
online transaction sets offered in a HIPAA-compliant, secure environment.

With time being such a precious
commodity, Accumedic’s HL7 EDI Interface enables multiple data transaction and reporting systems to

synergistically, maximizing

The AccuMed Patient Portal
revolutionizes patient care, combining technology with healthcare. Seamlessly integrated with

## Compassionate home care, right when it matters most.

When everyday tasks begin to feel overwhelming, compassionate support can make all the difference.
Answered Prayer Home Care provides thoughtful, respectful in-home care designed to bring comfort,
dignity, and peace of mind to both clients and their families. Schedule an assessment today and
experience trusted home care services in Montgomery, Auburn, and Fairhope.

[Schedule a Free Assessment][39]
[Answered Prayer Home Care Services] 

# When Should You Consider Caregiving Assistance?

Answered Prayer Home Care Services helps individuals and families achieve a healthier, happier
quality of life by restoring independence and providing lasting peace of mind. Through
compassionate, personalized in-home care, clients are supported in maintaining safety, dignity, and
comfort in their own homes. Too often, the early signs that pediatric, special needs, or senior
in-home care is needed are overlooked. This can lead to caregiver burnout, increased stress, and
even personal injury—ultimately making it difficult for families to care for themselves and those
they love. Timely professional support ensures both clients and caregivers receive the care,
balance, and relief they deserve.

[Find Out When...][40]

[Families Trust Answered Prayer] 

## Why Families Trust Answered Prayer Home Care Services

Answered Prayer Home Care Services offers warm, attentive in-home care tailored to each individual’s
unique situation. Whether helping a loved one remain safe and independent at home or providing daily
support across a range of needs, our professional caregivers are carefully matched to your family’s
preferences. We serve Montgomery, Auburn, and Fairhope with a focus on dignity, comfort, and open
communication.
* Personalized in-home care that supports independence
* Professional caregivers matched to your needs
* Assistance across pediatric, special needs, and elderly care
* Local service in Montgomery, Auburn, and Fairhope
* Peace of mind with compassionate, attentive support

[Answered Prayer Home Care Services] 

## Frequently Asked Questions
* ### Q1. How do I begin the process of getting in-home care for my loved one?
  
  A. To start, you can contact Answered Prayer Home Care Services to schedule a complimentary
  in-home assessment with one of their professionals. During this visit, they evaluate needs and
  discuss a care plan tailored to your situation.
* ### Q2. What happens during the initial care assessment?
  
  A. A member of the team will assess the individual’s strengths, needs, and preferences to create a
  custom care plan. They also discuss schedules and caregiver matching, and maintain clear
  communication with your family.
* ### Q3. What types of care services are available?
  
  A. The agency provides a wide range of supportive care services including personal care (bathing,
  dressing, grooming), meal help, medication assistance, transportation, companionship, respite
  care, and specialized care for Alzheimer’s, dementia, and chronic conditions.
* ### Q4. Do you offer care for children or only adults?
  
  A. Yes. They offer in-home care for pediatric clients with special needs, as well as adults and
  seniors who need supportive assistance in daily living.
* ### Q5. Can I get 24-hour care or flexible scheduling?

  A. A member of the team will assess the individual’s strengths, needs, and preferences to create a

  A. After the assessment, the team matches the best caregiver based on the individual’s needs and

## Why Philadelphia Families Choose A-Team Home Care

ACHC-accredited, Medicare-certified, and accepted by Community HealthChoices, VetAssist, and the
OPTIONS Program — A-Team is Philadelphia’s most credentialed in-home care agency.

#### ACHC Accredited — Above State Standards

Accreditation Commission for Health Care certification goes beyond Pennsylvania Department of Health
licensing — it’s the gold standard families use to verify quality before placement.

#### Medicare, Medicaid & Community HealthChoices

Accepted by Medicare, Medicaid, Keystone First CHC, UPMC Community HealthChoices, and PA Health &
Wellness — care is covered for most Philadelphia-area families at little or no out-of-pocket cost.

#### Family Caregivers Get Paid

Through Pennsylvania’s Family Caregiver Program, family members caring for a loved one can be hired
and compensated as official caregivers. A-Team handles all enrollment, training, and paperwork.

#### Medicare-Certified Skilled Nursing

RN and LPN skilled nursing, physical therapy, occupational therapy, and speech therapy — delivered
at home through a Medicare-certified home health agency.

## Why Philadelphia Families Choose A-Team Home Care

ACHC-accredited, Medicare-certified, and accepted by Community HealthChoices, VetAssist, and the
OPTIONS Program — A-Team is Philadelphia’s most credentialed in-home care agency.

#### ACHC Accredited — Above State Standards

Accreditation Commission for Health Care certification goes beyond Pennsylvania Department of Health
licensing — it’s the gold standard families use to verify quality before placement.

#### Medicare, Medicaid & Community HealthChoices

Accepted by Medicare, Medicaid, Keystone First CHC, UPMC Community HealthChoices, and PA Health &
Wellness — care is covered for most Philadelphia-area families at little or no out-of-pocket cost.

#### Family Caregivers Get Paid

Through Pennsylvania’s Family Caregiver Program, family members caring for a loved one can be hired
and compensated as official caregivers. A-Team handles all enrollment, training, and paperwork.

#### Medicare-Certified Skilled Nursing

RN and LPN skilled nursing, physical therapy, occupational therapy, and speech therapy — delivered
at home through a Medicare-certified home health agency.

## Frequently Asked Questions

[ Who needs home care services?
][68]

Home care helps seniors, individuals recovering from surgery or illness, people living with chronic
conditions or dementia, medically fragile children, and anyone who needs extra support to live
safely at home. It also gives family caregivers much-needed relief.

[ How do I get started with Atlanta House Cares?
][69]

Getting started is simple. Contact us for a free in-home assessment. We'll learn about your needs,
answer your questions, and build a personalized care plan — with no obligation.

[ Do you provide care for all ages?
][70]

Yes. Atlanta House Cares supports clients of every age, from medically fragile children through our
pediatric (GAPP) program to seniors needing memory care or skilled nursing.

[ Do you offer specialized care for chronic conditions?
][71]

Yes. We provide specialized support for clients living with dementia, Alzheimer's disease,
Parkinson's disease, disabilities, and other chronic health conditions.

[ Where in Atlanta do you provide care?
][72]

We serve families throughout the Greater Atlanta area, including Fulton, DeKalb, Gwinnett, Cobb,
Clayton, and surrounding counties. Call us to confirm coverage in your specific area.

#### About Benchmark

## Who We Are

Benchmark Family Services is a network of professional, therapeutic foster homes and committed staff
across two states with the goal of providing stable out-of-home placements for children in need. We
work alongside child welfare agencies to provide stable care to youth in the least restrictive
setting possible as they work toward their goals. The results we see in the youth that pass through
our care encourage us to carry on in our mission to give even the most traumatized and troubled
children a safe and stable home.

[ Read More ][38]

#### What We Do

## What Is Therapeutic Foster Care?

How is therapeutic foster care different than regular foster care? Therapeutic foster homes care for
youth who have been severely neglected or abused. These therapeutic foster children can have a
number of presenting issues that are a direct result from their past. We also serve a number of
children with emotional, mental and physical disabilities. Most of the youth we serve are
adolescents who require more intensive care and support.

[ Read More ][39]

#### What People Say About Us

## Testimonials

I would just like to say how proud I am to be a member of the Benchmark family. They have excellent,
professional, and compassionate staff. They always meet the needs of our children, and are great at
supporting foster parents. As a 41 year veteran of being a foster parent, I’ve worked with many
agencies – and Benchmark is superb!
Terri PottsBFS Foster Parent
Words to describe Benchmark: supportive, honest, caring and passionate about helping children &
foster families! We are so blessed to have such an amazing agency!
Grant & Kimbra LoughBFS Foster Parents
Benchmark has been amazing to us! We could not have asked for a better organization for us & our
foster kids. Anytime we need help with anything from daycare vouchers to questions about services to
working with IEP’s, they are quick to respond. Our TSS has been there to answer our silly questions,
helped us navigate emotional & behavioral issues & anything else that pops up. We could not have
done this without them!
Mike and Donna BuckBFS Foster Parents
Benchmark staff have been very easy to work with. They have been very caring, supportive and helpful
with anything we need, even at odd hours of the day. The staff goes above and beyond to help make
things flow and make life less stressful. They have definitely been a big support to my husband and
I as new foster parents and have the kids’ best interest in mind.
Mechelle and Herman GarciaBFS Foster Parents
Benchmark is an awesome foster care agency! The staff is great to work with and they are always
there to support the kids and foster families! Working with Benchmark has been a great experience.
Jen SheltonBFS Foster Parents
Benchmark Family Services has been wonderful to us over the past two years. They are there to help
you and support you through everything going on. They have great training options, and are willing
to accommodate your specific training schedule and needs. When you come to Benchmark, it’s like
“welcome to the family”, and not just welcome to another agency.
Jorden & Lacey BaldridgeBFS Foster Parents
I thank God for Benchmark, they are always there. With any doubts, fears, or concerns, they are
always there to help and to listen. It’s been a wonderful experience!
Shane & Sabrina BackBFS Foster Parents

compassionate, therapeutic mobile massage services thoughtfully tailored to support each client’s

A proud United States Army veteran who served honorably for eight years, Diane brings a strong
foundation of professionalism, communication, and service into her work. Her background includes
more than a decade of public service, including roles with the City of Alachua, the 8th Judicial

## My Therapeutic Approach

###### 
###### Healing is not one-size-fits-all. Every person carries a unique story, level of comfort, and
###### therapeutic needs. My approach is centered on building trust through clear communication,
###### professionalism, and genuine connection. 
###### 
###### A strong therapeutic relationship creates the foundation for individualized care. Every
###### session is guided by mutual trust, respect, and collaboration while recognizing that no two
###### clients or paths to healing are exactly alike.
###### 
###### Whether assisting with pain relief, recovery, nervous system regulation, scar tissue care, or
###### trauma-informed support, sessions are approached with a variety of therapeutic techniques.
###### Supportive tools may be incorporated when appropriate to help with comfort, mobility,
###### healing, and overall well-being.
######  

## Therapeutic Services & Support

Explore the services available through Blue Ember Massage and the many ways care may be tailored to
your individual needs.

### [Dolphin Neurostim™ MPS Therapy][14]

Dolphin Neurostim™ MPS Therapy uses Microcurrent Point Stimulation (MPS) Therapy to support pain
management, scar release, vagus nerve support, nervous system regulation, sensory balancing, and the
body’s natural healing response as part of individualized therapeutic care.

### Pain Managment & Recovery

Persistent pain and muscular tension may continue affecting daily life long after injury, overuse,
or chronic stress. Treatment plans may incorporate Dolphin Neurostim™ MPS Therapy and hands-on
bodywork to address chronic pain, physical discomfort, and tension throughout the body. 

### Trauma-Informed & PTSD Support

Support for veterans, first responders, and individuals experiencing PTSD or trauma-related tension,
including survivors and those navigating the lasting effects of trauma. Care is approached with
communication, predictability, professional boundaries, and sensitivity to comfort throughout the
session.

### Therapeutic Bodywork & Specialized Techniques

Therapeutic bodywork may incorporate a variety of hands-on techniques, including Deep Tissue,
Swedish Massage, Neuromuscular Therapy, Trigger Point Therapy, Reflexology, and other modalities
based on your body's needs each session.

### [Scar Release Therapy][15]

Scar tissue-focused therapeutic care may incorporate manual cross fiber friction therapy and Dolphin
Neurostim™ MPS Therapy to support tissue mobility, comfort, healing, and recovery following injury,
surgery, or trauma to the tissue.

### Therapeutic Hot Stones

Heated Himalayan salt stones may be incorporated when appropriate to provide warmth, encourage
muscle relaxation, complement hands-on bodywork, and enhance comfort while supporting individualized
care. Himalayan salt stones have long been valued in holistic wellness practices.

# What to Expect

From your first conversation to the day of your appointment, every session is approached with
communication, professionalism, and thoughtful care.

## My Therapeutic Approach

###### 
###### Healing is not one-size-fits-all. Every person carries a unique story, level of comfort, and
###### therapeutic needs. My approach is centered on building trust through clear communication,
###### professionalism, and genuine connection. 
###### 
###### A strong therapeutic relationship creates the foundation for individualized care. Every
###### session is guided by mutual trust, respect, and collaboration while recognizing that no two
###### clients or paths to healing are exactly alike.
###### 
###### Whether assisting with pain relief, recovery, nervous system regulation, scar tissue care, or
###### trauma-informed support, sessions are approached with a variety of therapeutic techniques.
###### Supportive tools may be incorporated when appropriate to help with comfort, mobility,
###### healing, and overall well-being.
######  

## Therapeutic Services & Support

Explore the services available through Blue Ember Massage and the many ways care may be tailored to
your individual needs.

### [Dolphin Neurostim™ MPS Therapy][14]

Dolphin Neurostim™ MPS Therapy uses Microcurrent Point Stimulation (MPS) Therapy to support pain
management, scar release, vagus nerve support, nervous system regulation, sensory balancing, and the
body’s natural healing response as part of individualized therapeutic care.

### Pain Managment & Recovery

Persistent pain and muscular tension may continue affecting daily life long after injury, overuse,
or chronic stress. Treatment plans may incorporate Dolphin Neurostim™ MPS Therapy and hands-on
bodywork to address chronic pain, physical discomfort, and tension throughout the body. 

### Trauma-Informed & PTSD Support

Support for veterans, first responders, and individuals experiencing PTSD or trauma-related tension,
including survivors and those navigating the lasting effects of trauma. Care is approached with
communication, predictability, professional boundaries, and sensitivity to comfort throughout the
session.

### Therapeutic Bodywork & Specialized Techniques

Therapeutic bodywork may incorporate a variety of hands-on techniques, including Deep Tissue,
Swedish Massage, Neuromuscular Therapy, Trigger Point Therapy, Reflexology, and other modalities
based on your body's needs each session.

### [Scar Release Therapy][15]

Scar tissue-focused therapeutic care may incorporate manual cross fiber friction therapy and Dolphin
Neurostim™ MPS Therapy to support tissue mobility, comfort, healing, and recovery following injury,
surgery, or trauma to the tissue.

### Therapeutic Hot Stones

Heated Himalayan salt stones may be incorporated when appropriate to provide warmth, encourage
muscle relaxation, complement hands-on bodywork, and enhance comfort while supporting individualized
care. Himalayan salt stones have long been valued in holistic wellness practices.

# What to Expect

From your first conversation to the day of your appointment, every session is approached with
communication, professionalism, and thoughtful care. 

After you contact Blue Ember Massage, we'll discuss your needs, location, and scheduling preferences
to determine the best approch for your session.

You will be sent required paperwork via email to complete before your first session. You'll receive
confirmation prior to your appointment. 

A quiet, comfortable space large enough for a massage table is ideal whenever possible in the agreed
upon location.  

Massage therapy is provided using therapeutic techniques and supportive tools when appropriate for
your care.

Payment is collected at time of booking or within a set timeframe after booking is confirmed. See
[FAQ][16] for additional information. 

### Frequently Asked Questions

### Booking & Scheduling

How do I book a session?


Appointments may be requested by phone, text message, email, or contact form. After reaching out,
we'll discuss your therapeutic needs, preferred location, scheduling availability, and the best
approach for your session before confirming your appointment.

Do you require a deposit?


Deposits may be required for appointments involving extended travel distances or specialty
scheduling needs. Any required deposit will be discussed during booking and applied toward the total
cost of your session.

Do you offer recurring appointments?


Yes. Recurring appointments may be scheduled weekly, biweekly, monthly, or as needed. Sessions may
be tailored to support ongoing pain management, recovery, maintenance care, and overall wellness.

When is payment collected?


Payment is collected at the time of booking or within a designated timeframe following booking
confirmation. Additional payment details will be provided during scheduling.

How far in advance should I schedule?


Scheduling in advance is encouraged whenever possible, especially for preferred appointment times or
extended travel locations. Same-week or last-minute availability may occasionally be available
depending on scheduling.

What is your cancellation policy?


Appointments canceled with at least 48 hrs' notice may be rescheduled without charge. Cancellations

amazing.

## Find Care Near You

## Christian Rekindles Her Joy

### SLP, Phoenix, AZ

After years in public schools, Christian transitioned to home health to reconnect with her passion
for speech therapy. With less paperwork, a more flexible schedule, and meaningful one-on-one time,
she helps kiddos like Chloe thrive using eye gaze technology — all in the comfort of her own home.

[Meet More Caregivers][42]
[Christian rekindles her joy]

Christian M.

Speech-Language Pathologist

Phoenix, AZ

## Sasha’s Rewarding Life

### LPN, Jacksonville, FL

Sasha joined Care Options for Kids looking for a more meaningful, less stressful nursing experience
— and found precisely that. She loves the one-on-one connection with patients, the supportive team,
and the flexibility to balance work and life. Moments like seeing Jesse’s heartfelt smile remind her
she’s exactly where she’s meant to be.

[Meet More Caregivers][43]
[Sasha's rewarding life]

Sasha E.

Licensed Practical Nurse

Jacksonville, FL

## Laura Gets to Play All Day

### DPT, Phoenix, AZ

Laura, a physical therapist, loves that her job feels like play — while making a real impact.
Working with Presley since age three, she’s witnessed incredible progress through home-based therapy
tailored to daily life. Laura enjoys helping kids thrive right where they’re most comfortable.

[Meet More Caregivers][44]
[Laura gets to play all day]

Laura N.

Doctor of Physical Therapy

Phoenix, AZ

## Mary Rose Finds Her Calling

### Assistant Director, RN, Jacksonville, FL

Drawn to Care Options for Kids by a former colleague’s glowing recommendation, Mary Rose found more
than just a job — she found her calling with a supportive, experienced care team. The hands-on
tracheostomy and ventilator training she received gave her the confidence to provide the highest
level of care.

[Meet More Caregivers][45]

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

nutraceuticals and supplements.

improved skin health and gut microbiome function. This enables precision nutrition for cancer
patients as well as wellness and longevity applications aimed at increasing health span, not just

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][69]

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

From its beginning in 2002, INTEGRATED manufacturing philosophy has been to develop, design and
engineer industry standard pressure and flow control equipment. INTEGRATED^{®} wholly owned global
API licensed manufacturing facilities provide the latest designed Equipment, Spare Parts, Elastomers
and Repair & Remanufacturing (Recertification) services utilized in the drilling, well servicing and
production sectors of the Oil & Gas Industry worldwide.

## Our Services

Kidscare Home Health currently offers home therapy and private duty nursing. We are committed to
providing you and your child the highest quality care with the highest quality specialists.

### Private Duty Nursing

Our highly qualified nurses work alongside our therapists, providing children the best possible care
specific to your child’s needs 7 days a week, 24 hours a day.

[Learn More ][48]

### Home Therapy

Our diverse team of specialists are experts and work with children in a variety of areas including:
Physical, Occupational, and Speech/Language Therapy.

## Mission Statement

KidsCare Home Health is committed to building on our foundation of changing lives through
**C.A.R.E.**

Deeply rooted in the philosophy that excellence is achieved through continuous improvement, KidsCare
Home Health is committed to offering our employees a stable, nurturing work environment, and to
growing within the pediatric communities in the areas we service and beyond.

Our commitment to excellence in service is surpassed only by our commitment to ethical
professionalism, personal integrity, and dedication to the children we serve and the lives we have
the privilege of touching.

[Read More][52]

## Service Areas

KidsCare Home Health provides services nationwide and is continuing to expand to more states.

## About Us

KidsCare Home Health is a pediatric home health agency serving children with special needs across
the country. We focus on nursing, speech therapy, physical therapy, and occupational therapy as well
as provide case management for children up to 18 years old.

KidsCare Home Health has been providing quality pediatric home health care to the Dallas/Fort Worth
metroplex since 2003, when speech therapist and company owner Cortney Baker started treating
children in their homes.

# Compassionate, high-quality pediatric home health services that help children thrive in the
# comfort and security of their homes.

## M&M Healing Hands Home Health Services, LLC specialize in a range of home health services for
## children.

[A pediatric home health nurse sits a young child in the comfort of her own home, emphasizing the
importance of pediatric home health care.]

## What We Do

## [Licensed Nursing Care][22]

Our licensed nurses provide in-home medical care such as, but not limited to, medication
administration, wound care, respiratory care, tube feedings, and management of chronic conditions
like asthma and diabetes.

## [Certified Home Health Aides][23]

Our certified aides assist with activities of daily living (ADLs), providing support for families
with tasks such as, but not limited to, bathing, feeding, functional mobility, and hygiene. Our
aides are compassionate, reliable, and committed to building a bond with the children they care for.

## Why Choose Us?

Empathetic Leadership Family-Centered Care A Trusted Team Care Coordination Insurance & Billing
Assistance

Our CEO’s personal journey with pediatric home health care informs every decision we make. He is
deeply committed to ensuring that every child and family we work with receives the same level of
compassionate, high-quality care that supported his own family.

Understanding the physical, emotional, and logistical challenges that families face is at the core
of our service. We work closely with families to provide the support, education, and resources
needed to navigate the complexities of caring for a child with medical needs. We believe that family
is at the heart of pediatric care. We actively involve families in the care process, and empower
them in their child’s care.

Our licensed nurses, and aides are more than just healthcare providers. They are caregivers who
understand the unique needs of pediatric patients and their families. Many of our team members have
a personal experience with pediatric medical conditions and caregiving, making them not only
qualified but deeply empathetic.

Our multidisciplinary team works together to create a comprehensive care plan for each child. We
coordinate with pediatricians, specialists, and other medical providers to ensure seamless,
well-rounded care is provided.

Navigating insurance and billing can be overwhelming. Our team is here to help you understand your
options, ensure eligibility, and manage the financial aspects of care, making the process as easy as
possible.

## Our Values

### Compassion

We treat every child and family with the highest level of kindness, empathy, and respect.

### Integrity

We operate with honesty, transparency, and accountability in all aspects of our care.

### Excellence

Following evidence based practice and providing continued education ensures that we provide the
highest standard of care in all of our services.

### Collaboration

We work closely with families and their healthcare team to ensure comprehensive, coordinated care is
provided.

## Ensuring Quality Pediatric Home Health Services Through Licensing and Accreditation

M&M Healing Hands Home Health Services, LLC is actively completing the required state licensing
process through the California Department of Public Health. This approval allows us to officially
provide licensed pediatric nursing, home health aide services, and care coordination in the home.
Once this step is finalized, we will move into the accreditation phase through a nationally
recognized accrediting body. Accreditation includes a detailed review of our safety procedures,
clinical standards, staff training, and care quality to ensure that our services meet the highest
level of professional excellence.

While we complete these important requirements, our team is preparing all systems, care protocols,
and support resources so we can begin serving families as soon as licensure is granted. We will
announce our official start date for accepting new clients shortly, and we are excited to support
children and families across Northern California.

## What This Means For You

This process ensures that every part of our organization meets strict standards for safety, quality,
and family-focused care. It means your child will receive services from **We are in the licensing phase and moving into accreditation afterward.

# Bringing Pediatric Care and Hope Back Home

### A home pediatric nursing team that helps medically fragile clients and their families thrive. 

### A Home Pediatric Nursing Team Focused on Your Family’s Medical Ease

[Healthcare professionals interacting with a child in a medical or home care setting.]

Optimum Pediatric Services is a team of experienced home care nurses and clinicians focused on the
care and management of medically fragile children. 

 

Since 2016, we have worked closely with children navigating short and long-term medical conditions
and have supported parents in managing their caregiving duties, helping our clients and their
families to thrive. 

[A joyful mother and child outdoors, smiling and enjoying time together.]

#### Trusted by Georgia families for more than 10 years! 

[A smiling nurse or caregiver supporting a child in a wheelchair, promoting compassionate care.]

### Serving more than 45+ counties across Georgia, our nurses help our clients and their families by
### providing:  

[[Icon of a medical professional with a stethoscope, representing healthcare or nursing
services]][14]

Personalized Care. Our nurses uniquely tailor their visits to the individual needs of each client
based on their caseload.

[[Icon of a medicine bottle with a pill, symbolizing prescriptions, medication, or medical
care.]][15]

Treatment & Medication. Our nurses administer medication and assist with treatment plans prescribed
by physicians.

[[Icon of a rubber duck, representing child-friendly care, pediatric services, or comfort.]][16]

Hygiene & Exercise. Our nurses assist with ADLs when required by the plan of care and are supportive
of assigned physical therapists as part of the client's treatment plan.

### We also take care of the caregivers that make a difference everyday by supporting them with: 

[[Icon of two speech bubbles representing communication or consultation.]][17]

Parent & Physician Communication. Our supervisory team encompasses the coordination of care between
physicians, specialists, and parents to assist with the client's treatment goals.

[[Icon of a hand holding a heart, symbolizing care and support.]][18]

Caregiver Support. We help answer questions and provide the assistance needed to establish a care
routine that works.

[[Superhero symbolizing assistance or caregiving.]][19]

Advocacy. We are actively involved with non-profit groups dedicated to funding research to improve
and/or cure the conditions we treat. 

[A happy mother and child outdoors, sharing a joyful moment together.]

### We provide pediatric nursing care for more than 20 different types of medical conditions and
### treatments.

• Feeding disorders (Cleft Lip/Palate, NGT/GT/JT)

• Premature Birth

• Neuromuscular Disorders

• Congenital Anomalies

• Spinal Cord Injuries

• Anoxic and Traumatic Brain Injuries

• Colostomies

• Neoplastic Diseases

• Tracheotomies

• Mechanical Ventilation

• Respiratory Syndromes and Dysfunctions

• Gastrointestinal Disorders

• Cardiovascular Anomalies

• Hematologic and Immunologic Disorders

• Endocrine Disorders (Including Insulin Pumps)

[circle texture-06.png]

#### DID YOU KNOW…

With the proper support, some medically fragile children can have a better chance to become
independent and excel professionally.

# Bringing Pediatric Care and Hope Back Home

### A home pediatric nursing team that helps medically fragile clients and their families thrive. 

### A Home Pediatric Nursing Team Focused on Your Family’s Medical Ease

[Healthcare professionals interacting with a child in a medical or home care setting.]

Optimum Pediatric Services is a team of experienced home care nurses and clinicians focused on the
care and management of medically fragile children. 

 

Since 2016, we have worked closely with children navigating short and long-term medical conditions
and have supported parents in managing their caregiving duties, helping our clients and their
families to thrive. 

[A joyful mother and child outdoors, smiling and enjoying time together.]

#### Trusted by Georgia families for more than 10 years! 

[A smiling nurse or caregiver supporting a child in a wheelchair, promoting compassionate care.]

### Serving more than 45+ counties across Georgia, our nurses help our clients and their families by
### providing:  

[[Icon of a medical professional with a stethoscope, representing healthcare or nursing
services]][14]

Personalized Care. Our nurses uniquely tailor their visits to the individual needs of each client
based on their caseload.

[[Icon of a medicine bottle with a pill, symbolizing prescriptions, medication, or medical
care.]][15]

Treatment & Medication. Our nurses administer medication and assist with treatment plans prescribed
by physicians.

[[Icon of a rubber duck, representing child-friendly care, pediatric services, or comfort.]][16]

Hygiene & Exercise. Our nurses assist with ADLs when required by the plan of care and are supportive
of assigned physical therapists as part of the client's treatment plan.

### We also take care of the caregivers that make a difference everyday by supporting them with: 

[[Icon of two speech bubbles representing communication or consultation.]][17]

Parent & Physician Communication. Our supervisory team encompasses the coordination of care between
physicians, specialists, and parents to assist with the client's treatment goals.

[[Icon of a hand holding a heart, symbolizing care and support.]][18]

Caregiver Support. We help answer questions and provide the assistance needed to establish a care
routine that works.

[[Superhero symbolizing assistance or caregiving.]][19]

Advocacy. We are actively involved with non-profit groups dedicated to funding research to improve
and/or cure the conditions we treat. 

[A happy mother and child outdoors, sharing a joyful moment together.]

### We provide pediatric nursing care for more than 20 different types of medical conditions and
### treatments.

• Feeding disorders (Cleft Lip/Palate, NGT/GT/JT)

• Premature Birth

• Neuromuscular Disorders

• Congenital Anomalies

• Spinal Cord Injuries

• Anoxic and Traumatic Brain Injuries

• Colostomies

• Neoplastic Diseases

• Tracheotomies

• Mechanical Ventilation

• Respiratory Syndromes and Dysfunctions

• Gastrointestinal Disorders

• Cardiovascular Anomalies

• Hematologic and Immunologic Disorders

• Endocrine Disorders (Including Insulin Pumps)

[circle texture-06.png]

With the proper support, some medically fragile children can have a better chance to become
independent and excel professionally.

Understanding your business and its value… presenting the company in its very best light and finding

About us

## Introduction

Sunburst Healthcare was established in Nov 2017 at Pune. We at Sunburst Healthcare, are committed to
providing complete range of professional home healthcare services to our patients and clients.
Rapidly changing Healthcare sector in India has led to the growth of Home Health Care industry.

Sunburst follows best practices in medical care and well established protocols and standards.
Sunburst Healthcare has provided over 55600 individual services to more than 2000 patients in Pune,
Mumbai and Rest of Maharashtra. We provide healthcare at reasonable cost in the comfort of your
home. We aim to prevent unnecessary hospital stay and expenses. We believe a major portion of
healthcare should be available at home. 

[Dr. Sujata Malik (CEO) Sunburst HealthCare Pvt. Ltd.]

## About Us

J.H. Whitney, established in 1946 by the industrialist and philanthropist, John Hay “Jock” Whitney,
was one of the first U.S. private equity firms and is often credited with pioneering the development
of the private equity industry. Today, J.H. Whitney is a leader in the private equity industry,
having invested in over 400 companies since formation and currently manages approximately $1.0
billion in private capital. J.H. Whitney remains privately owned by its investing professionals and
our main activity is to provide private equity capital to small and middle market companies with
strong growth prospects in a number of industries including consumer, healthcare, specialty
manufacturing, and business services.  We are currently investing from our seventh private equity
fund whose investors include leading foundations, universities, pension funds and other
institutions.


History:

Founded as one of the country’s first private equity firms in 1946 by John Hay “Jock” Whitney, J.H.
Whitney was formed with the objective of providing capital and professional assistance to
entrepreneurs growing companies and reshaping industries. J.H. Whitney's rich history of success in
small and middle market investing began with the nation’s first post-World War II leveraged buyout,
Spencer Chemicals, by converting a munitions plant into a fertilizer facility. Shortly thereafter,
J.H. Whitney introduced the world to Minute Maid Orange Juice, a product in part developed in the
kitchen of J.H. Whitney’s original Rockefeller Center, New York offices.



With his personal investment of $5 million in 1946 to capitalize J.H. Whitney, Jock Whitney set the
stage for a significant change in American capitalism. Our firm honors Jock’s legacy today by
continuing his vision of providing capital and assistance to companies with the potential to achieve
sustained superior performance.


The Firm’s early success in the 1940s with private equity investing led other prominent families to
fund private equity activities in the ensuing years. Over the succeeding several decades, new and
existing private equity firms received significant amounts of investment capital from leading
foundations, universities and institutions. J.H. Whitney pursued a similar model in 1990 when we
raised our first private partnership apart from the Whitney family. Today, J.H. Whitney is investing
its seventh outside private equity fund and continues to attract its capital from leading
foundations, universities, pension funds and other institutions.


J.H. Whitney's Focus and Market Niche:

We invest principally in small and middle market buyouts and recapitalizations of growth-oriented
companies based in the U.S.  This investment focus has guided our activities for decades, and we
believe our dedication to this market niche enhances our ability to generate superior risk-adjusted
returns for our investors. 


We are guided by the parameters outlined below. 
* Target Company Revenue:          $50 million to $500 million
* Target Transaction Size:              $50 million to $500 million

Investment Model:

We seek companies that have attractive long term growth and profitability characteristics.  Educated
by the successes and challenges of our prior investments, we have established several important
practices that have enabled us to consistently generate top quartile returns for our investors.
* We use debt capital to enhance but not drive our investment returns. We are focused on long-term
  equity value creation through growth of cash flow instead of financial engineering. This approach
  ensures that our companies have ample financial and operating flexibility to pursue growth
  opportunities and, thereby, sustainable equity value creation.
* We believe that equity value is built through active post-investment leadership.  Though we are
  highly involved investors and board members at each of our companies, we are not operators.  We
  believe we can be most effective as investors when we have the ability to provide leadership to
  our companies through board representation and close working relationships with our management
  teams.  
* We dedicate substantial resources to every investment.  Our prudent investment pace and relatively
  small portfolio ensures careful oversight and proper checks and balances throughout our investment
  cycle.

## About Us

J.H. Whitney, established in 1946 by the industrialist and philanthropist, John Hay “Jock” Whitney,
was one of the first U.S. private equity firms and is often credited with pioneering the development
of the private equity industry. Today, J.H. Whitney is a leader in the private equity industry,
having invested in over 400 companies since formation and currently manages approximately $1.0
billion in private capital. J.H. Whitney remains privately owned by its investing professionals and
our main activity is to provide private equity capital to small and middle market companies with
strong growth prospects in a number of industries including consumer, healthcare, specialty
manufacturing, and business services.  We are currently investing from our seventh private equity
fund whose investors include leading foundations, universities, pension funds and other
institutions.


History:

Founded as one of the country’s first private equity firms in 1946 by John Hay “Jock” Whitney, J.H.
Whitney was formed with the objective of providing capital and professional assistance to
entrepreneurs growing companies and reshaping industries. J.H. Whitney's rich history of success in
small and middle market investing began with the nation’s first post-World War II leveraged buyout,
Spencer Chemicals, by converting a munitions plant into a fertilizer facility. Shortly thereafter,
J.H. Whitney introduced the world to Minute Maid Orange Juice, a product in part developed in the
kitchen of J.H. Whitney’s original Rockefeller Center, New York offices.



With his personal investment of $5 million in 1946 to capitalize J.H. Whitney, Jock Whitney set the
stage for a significant change in American capitalism. Our firm honors Jock’s legacy today by
continuing his vision of providing capital and assistance to companies with the potential to achieve
sustained superior performance.


The Firm’s early success in the 1940s with private equity investing led other prominent families to
fund private equity activities in the ensuing years. Over the succeeding several decades, new and
existing private equity firms received significant amounts of investment capital from leading
foundations, universities and institutions. J.H. Whitney pursued a similar model in 1990 when we
raised our first private partnership apart from the Whitney family. Today, J.H. Whitney is investing
its seventh outside private equity fund and continues to attract its capital from leading
foundations, universities, pension funds and other institutions.


J.H. Whitney's Focus and Market Niche:

We invest principally in small and middle market buyouts and recapitalizations of growth-oriented
companies based in the U.S.  This investment focus has guided our activities for decades, and we
believe our dedication to this market niche enhances our ability to generate superior risk-adjusted
returns for our investors. 


We are guided by the parameters outlined below. 
* Target Company Revenue:          $50 million to $500 million
* Target Transaction Size:              $50 million to $500 million
* Target Equity Investment:           $25 million to $200 million


As we pursue investment opportunities, we may discover attractive companies that are either above or
below one or more of the ranges listed above.  For example, many attractive, growth-oriented
companies are under $50 million in revenue, but their strong cash flows, profit margins and growth
prospects typically lead to transaction sizes and equity investments for J.H. Whitney within the
ranges shown above. 


Investment Model:

We seek companies that have attractive long term growth and profitability characteristics.  Educated
by the successes and challenges of our prior investments, we have established several important
practices that have enabled us to consistently generate top quartile returns for our investors.
* We use debt capital to enhance but not drive our investment returns. We are focused on long-term
  equity value creation through growth of cash flow instead of financial engineering. This approach
  ensures that our companies have ample financial and operating flexibility to pursue growth
  opportunities and, thereby, sustainable equity value creation.
* We believe that equity value is built through active post-investment leadership.  Though we are
  highly involved investors and board members at each of our companies, we are not operators.  We
  believe we can be most effective as investors when we have the ability to provide leadership to
  our companies through board representation and close working relationships with our management
  teams.  
* We dedicate substantial resources to every investment.  Our prudent investment pace and relatively
  small portfolio ensures careful oversight and proper checks and balances throughout our investment
  cycle.
